notes: Haiku 4.5 on the operator's Claude subscription via freecode's anthropic OAuth auth mode (freecode auth login anthropic). Pair with claude-code-haiku; host-only, --no-meter, for the same reasons. No --max-turns (removed 2026-10-11): the rivals have no turn cap, only the shared per-trial timeout, so a freecode-only 40-call cap cut its hardest trials short — 9 of 60 MiniMax trials on 2026-10-11 ended at the cap with a wrap-up summary instead of an edit, while claude-code and opencode each ran past 40 calls in 8. freecode's own default is unbounded, matching Claude Code's headless mode; the timeout bounds every agent alike.
